semantics.clock: All input bits are sampled on positive clk edges, as explicitly specified.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset returns to idle and clears done on a rising edge; reset overrides input reception.
semantics.framing: While idle, sampled 0 is a start. The next eight sampled bits are data, irrespective of value. The following sample must be 1 for success.
semantics.done: Assert for the cycle immediately after sampling a valid stop bit; clear on the next rising edge. That next edge may accept a new start bit.
semantics.error_recovery: If the expected stop sample is 0, ignore further zeros until sampling 1. This recovery 1 does not assert done. Only subsequent samples may start a new byte.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state is specified; verification establishes synchronous reset before checking defined reception behavior.
semantics.data_order: Data is LSB first, but no payload output exists and data values do not affect framing.

numeric.data_count: 3-bit unsigned index from 0 through 7 for exactly eight data samples
numeric.arithmetic: No payload arithmetic, rounding or saturation

verification.oracle: Independent integer phase tracker derived from original framing description
verification.sampling: Drive at falling edge, check output before rising edge and after NBA settling
verification.coverage: All 256 data values, adjacent frames, idle, missing stop and delayed recovery, long low stream, reset at every frame position and deterministic random streams
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original asks to identify when bytes have been correctly received without explicitly describing pulse width
specification_ambiguities.resolution: One-cycle completion indication beginning at the successful stop sample, with no extra latency

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original specifies synchronous reset but no initialization
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No initialized RTL registers and no expected pre-reset value
